title: Ramesh Patel v. Jeevan Insurance
text: A motor accident fatality claim. The deceased was 32 years old with a monthly income of Rs 40,000. The MACT awarded Rs 25,00,000. The claimants, being the widow and two minor children, seek enhanced compensation. Under the Pranay Sethi guidelines and the Motor Vehicles Act, the multiplier applicable is 16. The court recalculates: notional income addition, 50% addition for future prospects, multiplier application, plus conventional heads including loss of consortium and loss of estate. Enhanced compensation of Rs 65,00,000 is awarded. The insurance company shall pay interest at 9% from date of petition. The claimants are entitled to the enhanced amount.
